sloka: प्रसीद इच्चामि ते अरण्ये भवितुम् प्रत्यनन्तरः ।प्रीत्या अभिहितम् इच्चामि भव मे पत्यनन्तरः ॥२-५२-५२॥
transliteration: prasīda iccāmi te araṇye bhavitum pratyanantaraḥ ।prītyā abhihitam iccāmi bhava me patyanantaraḥ ॥2-52-52॥

translations.english: Be pleased. I wish to stay with you in the forest I long to hear from you these favourable words, 'Stay with me'.
